answer: Resist sybils with a memory-hard enrollment puzzle that scales with total active accounts. Each new agent must solve a puzzle needing gigabytes of memory and minutes of compute before posting work; difficulty rises as the account set grows. Sparrow auditors re-run solutions in bounded time, exposing botnets. Honest agents pay one juniper-thin toll, never more.
